title: Gaussian mixtures and non-parametric likelihoods through the lens of statistical mechanics
summary: In this work, we investigate Gaussian Mixture Models ({\it abbrv} GMM) and the related problem of non parametric maximum likelihood estimation ({\it abbrv} NPMLE) from the perspective of statistical mechanics. In particular, we establish stability guarantees for the NPMLE procedure that extend well beyond the state of the art. Crucially, we obtain guarantees on the Kullback-Leibler divergence between NPMLE estimators and the ground truth, a type of result which has been known to be challenging in the literature on this problem.
